contents: A roguelike plate game based around surviving random events.
Survive events that raise the intensity, unlocking more and more severe events.
Collect Clocks to deduct Time, the primary goal for the next Cycle.
Cyclathrons (€) is a shared currency from Clocks or means for purchasing Cards.
Cards can be beneficial, harmful or both (Upgrades & Curses).

Survivors have unique abilities, different style and stats.

There are several vanilla changes (0.5x Air Drag, locked Breaking & Building).

contents.text: For Modrinth people, you are looking at a more polished version of the classic game but with the modern changes and additions from the Splintered Worlds update which has reached phase 2/3 and is now on content additions. The Discord link is found on the page.
